voiceSummary: India Power Corporation Limited, formerly DPSC Limited, is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. The National Company Law Tribunal, Hyderabad Bench, admitted the application on 15th May, 2026, suspending the Board of Directors' powers. The company published un-audited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026, in newspapers on 14th November, 2026. The advertisement is also available on the company website. The document includes a Bengali notice regarding the auction of secured assets by PNB Housing Finance Limited.

attchmntText: DPSC Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process- approved and taken on record the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: India Power Corporation Limited, undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since 15th May 2026, announced that its Resolution Professional Management Committee approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company recorded a profit of 1,036.33 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 336.46 lakhs in the same period last year. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, the profit was 1,656.62 lakhs, versus a loss of 23,769.33 lakhs in the prior year. The Resolution Professional, Ms. Srinivasa Mano Ranjani, confirmed the approval during the meeting held on 13th November 2026. Financial results are available on the company website.

voiceSummary: India Power Corporation Limited, undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since 15th May 2026, reports that its Resolution Professional Management Committee approved Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company recorded a profit of 1,036.33 lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a loss of 336.46 lakhs in the same period last year. For the six months ended 30th September 2026, the profit was 1,656.62 lakhs, versus a loss of 23,769.33 lakhs in the prior year. Revenue from operations stood at 18,698.00 lakhs for the quarter. The Resolution Professional, Ms. Srinivasa Mano Ranjani, confirmed the approval. The company remains under moratorium. Financial results are available on the company website.
